atherogenesis. Like obesity and diabetes, cardiovascular disease
is also a complex area of study with numerous gene-gene and
gene-diet interactions that have not been completely elucidat-
ed. However, more is known about the dyslipidemias, oﬀ ering
perhaps some early opportunities for individualized dietary 
intervention that are not yet possible for obesity or diabetes.
